title: The Last Instalment
logline: A family counts out the final payment on gold pawned years ago during a hard season, and walks home carrying back something they had almost stopped expecting to see again.

object.note: Object 10 (identity not chosen) could enter only if the family is willing to part with or pass on something connected to the closed debt. Never staged.

thread_in.thread: What arises by conditions can end by conditions: the kiln stops being fed, and the next film opens on something set down, a family's final payment on gold pawned years ago.

thread_out.thread: A burden set down makes room for stillness: a town temple's lay meditation class, where each person is sent to their own plain object.

requirements: A family willing to be filmed at a real pawn transaction and at home
A pawn business willing to allow filming at the counter
